definitions.gloss: to be thrilling; to be exciting; to set one's heart racing
definitions.explanation: To feel excitement, anticipation, or exhilaration. Literally 'the chest dances.' Used to describe the feeling of eager anticipation or being thrilled.

examples.japanese: {胸躍|むねおど}る⟦{冒険|ぼうけん}→冒険：03629_bouken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
{胸躍|むねおど}る⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I was given an exciting experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}{旅行|りょこう}→海外旅行：24321_kaigairyokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てている→立てる：01196_tateru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{躍|おど}る。
examples.english: When I'm planning an overseas trip, my heart races with excitement.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、⟦{遠足|えんそく}→遠足：04107_ensoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前日|ぜんじつ}→前日：03108_zenjitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{躍|おど}って⟦{眠|ねむ}れなかった→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: As a child, the night before a field trip I was always too excited to sleep.

notes:
Literally "the chest dances" — a vivid expression for excitement and anticipation. Often used as a modifier in the form {胸躍|むねおど}る + noun ({胸躍|むねおど}る⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧, {胸躍|むねおど}る⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧). Can also be used in the split form ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{躍|おど}る.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胸躍|むねおど}る⟦{冒険|ぼうけん}→冒険：03629_bouken⟧: a thrilling adventure
- {胸躍|むねおど}る⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: an exciting experience
- {胸躍|むねおど}る⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧: a thrilling moment
- ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{躍|おど}る: one's heart leaps with excitement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦わくわくする→ワクワクする：25801_wakuwakusuru⟧: to be excited, thrilled (more casual and colloquial)
- {心躍|こころおど}る: to be excited (very close synonym, slightly more literary)
- ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ときめく→ときめく：07363_tokimeku⟧: to have one's heart flutter (often romantic excitement)
- ⟦ドキドキする→ドキドキする：21628_dokidokisuru⟧: heart pounding (can be excitement or nervousness)
